critical_assumptions.assumption: Regulatory pressure on AI will remain high for 3+ years (not ease)
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Monitor Fed/SEC/OCC guidance quarterly; customer interviews on regulatory roadmap expectations
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: 90+ of interviewed CCOs believe regulatory pressure will increase

critical_assumptions.assumption: Willingness-to-pay: Large banks will pay $150-500K annually (median $250K)
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Pricing research interviews with 10 CCOs; quantify willingness-to-pay ranges
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: 70%+ of interviewed CCOs willing to pay >$150K; median >$200K

critical_assumptions.assumption: Sales cycle will be 4 months (based on Vol 2 buying process)
critical_assumptions.validation_method: First 3 customer sales cycles; track from first call to close
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: Average sales cycle 3-5 months (within forecast range)

critical_assumptions.assumption: Monthly churn will be 2% or lower (industry SaaS benchmark)
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Monitor first 3 customers' retention; measure monthly churn
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: Churn 3% or lower in first 6 months (including seasonal factors)

critical_assumptions.assumption: Our explainability engine will satisfy regulatory requirements (Fed bar)
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Test with regulatory consultants; assess against Federal Reserve AI guidance checklist
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: Expert review confirms compliance with Fed guidance; identified gaps if any

critical_assumptions.assumption: Integrated platform preferred over point solutions by 70%+ of customers
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Customer interviews about architecture preferences; compare willingness-to-pay for integrated vs. point
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: 70%+ prefer integrated; willing to pay 30%+ premium for integration

critical_assumptions.assumption: Gross margin 75% is achievable (cloud 15%, support 10%, other 0%)
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Build cost model from first customer implementation; track actual costs vs. budget
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: Gross margin achieves 70%+ (allowing for optimization post-launch)

critical_assumptions.assumption: Top 50 banks represent addressable market (not too concentrated)
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Post-first-3-customers, assess secondary segment (Top 100 banks) willingness-to-pay and buying process
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: Secondary segment shows 60%+ of willingness-to-pay of primary; adoption timeline reasonable

critical_assumptions.assumption: CAC of $120K is achievable through founder sales (founder leverage)
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Track actual sales costs per customer (team time, marketing spend, partner costs)

critical_assumptions.assumption: Competitors (ModelWatch, Regulatory AI) will not add compliance reporting in <12 months
critical_assumptions.validation_method: Monitor competitors monthly; assess product roadmap signals
critical_assumptions.success_criteria: Competitors have not launched integrated reporting in 6-month window

high_impact_high_likelihood: Explainability engine insufficient for regulatory bar (core product risk)
high_impact_medium_likelihood: Sales cycle extends beyond 6 months (cash burn increases)
high_impact_low_likelihood: Technology not feasible for model-agnostic explainability (6-month setback)
Major regulatory change makes our approach obsolete (market risk)
medium_impact_high_likelihood: Secondary segment adoption slower than primary (Year 2+ focus)
Implementation costs higher than budgeted (margin compression)
other_risks: Partnership channels slower to develop than expected (channel risk)
Fundraising difficult if first customers not successful (capital risk)

kill_criteria.criterion: Explainability engine insufficient: Regulatory consultants assess it doesn't meet Federal Reserve guidance in critical areas (e.g., decision explainability)
kill_criteria.measurement_method: Expert review by 2+ compliance consultants against Fed AI guidance checklist; identify material gaps
kill_criteria.kill_threshold: Critical gaps identified that require 3+ months development to fix

kill_criteria.criterion: Willingness-to-pay too low: Pricing research shows <50% of CCOs would pay >$150K annually
kill_criteria.measurement_method: Survey/interviews with 15+ target CCOs; calculate % willing to pay at different price points

kill_criteria.criterion: Customer acquisition impossible: First 3 customer acquisition takes >8 months each (extends cash runway >18 months)
kill_criteria.measurement_method: Track sales cycle of first 3 customers (from first call to close)
kill_criteria.kill_threshold: Average sales cycle >8 months; total time to 3 customers >24 months

kill_criteria.criterion: Monthly churn too high: First 3 customers show >5% monthly churn in months 4-6 (breaks LTV model)
kill_criteria.measurement_method: Track subscription status of first 3 customers monthly; calculate churn rate
kill_criteria.kill_threshold: Any customer churns before month 6; churn >5% monthly for any cohort

validation_roadmap.method: Pricing research interviews with 15 target CCOs; present scenarios and measure willingness
validation_roadmap.expected_learning: Clarify pricing band; identify price sensitivity
validation_roadmap.go_no_go_decision: If <50% willing to pay >$150K → kill. If 50-70% → pivot pricing. If 70%+ → proceed

validation_roadmap.method: Test product against Federal Reserve AI governance guidance; external consultant review
validation_roadmap.success_metric: Consultant assessment: compliant with guidance; gaps identified and manageable
validation_roadmap.expected_learning: Identify any regulatory gaps; assess buildability
validation_roadmap.go_no_go_decision: If critical gaps → rework product. If minor gaps → plan fixes. If compliant → proceed

validation_roadmap.method: Target Top 50 banks; execute founder sales process; track metrics
validation_roadmap.success_metric: Close 1 customer; document sales cycle, costs, success factors
validation_roadmap.expected_learning: Validate ICP, sales process, first customer profile
validation_roadmap.go_no_go_decision: If customer acquired in 4-6 months at <$150K cost → proceed. If >6 months or >$200K cost → re-evaluate GTM

validation_roadmap.method: Deploy with 3 customers; measure success metrics, churn, margin
validation_roadmap.success_metric: 3 customers in production; churn 3% or lower; margin 70% or higher
validation_roadmap.expected_learning: Validate business model economics; identify customer success requirements
validation_roadmap.go_no_go_decision: If churn >5% → pivot business model. If margin <60% → reduce scope. If metrics hit → scale

validation_roadmap.method: Post-3-customers, interview 10 banks in Top 100 (not Top 50); assess interest
validation_roadmap.success_metric: 70%+ of secondary segment show interest; WTP 60%+ of primary segment
validation_roadmap.expected_learning: Secondary segment viability; timeline to expansion
validation_roadmap.go_no_go_decision: If secondary weak → focus on primary. If strong → plan secondary expansion Month 6+

first_30_days: Pricing research: 15 CCO interviews on willingness-to-pay (target: 70%+ >$150K)
Competitor monitoring: Document competitive positioning and any announced features
Regulatory research: Confirm Federal Reserve guidance hasn't changed
target_learning: Pricing is viable (70%+ willing to pay >$150K)
No major regulatory changes that invalidate thesis
ICP is reachable (initial outreach response rate >10%)

mitigation_actions.action: Monitor Fed/SEC/OCC guidance; customer interviews on enforcement trajectory; if pressure easing detected, pivot to operational efficiency angle (cost savings, not compliance)
Run pricing research in Month 1; if <50% willing to pay >$150K, pivot to mid-market (lower price, higher volume)
Get regulatory consultant review Month 1-2; assess against Fed guidance; if gaps, allocate engineering time
Invest in customer success infrastructure (onboarding, training, support) before scaling; monitor churn monthly
If first customer acquisition >$150K in cost, shift to partnerships (lower CAC) instead of direct sales

unmitigatable_risks: Major regulatory change makes compliance approach obsolete (low probability, uncontrollable)
Severe recession reducing bank compliance budgets (low probability, structural)

assumptions: All assumptions grounded in Vols 1-6; this volume surfaces risks inherent in those volumes
data_gaps: Actual willingness-to-pay from real CCO conversations (using Vol 2 estimates as proxy)
Regulatory enforcement data (using Fed guidance as proxy for future enforcement)
confidence_rationale: Risk map is comprehensive across market, product, business model, and execution risks. Kill criteria are specific and measurable. Validation roadmap is realistic and sequenced logically. However, confidence is not higher because assumptions from Vols 1-6 are not yet validated in market (pricing, regulatory sufficiency, churn). Risk assessment relies on those upstream assumptions.
